services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: From interior wall refreshes to full exterior repaints, we handle residential and commercial projects with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decoration
services.desc: Full room redecorating, feature walls, ceilings, and woodwork. We protect your furniture and leave zero mess behind.

services.title: Exterior House Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior paint work on brick, render, and wood. We prepare surfaces properly to ensure lasting colour and protection.

services.title: Commercial Repainting
services.desc: Office, retail, and industrial painting tailored to your business needs. We work around your opening hours with minimal disruption.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Expert wallpaper installation and careful stripping of old paper. Pattern matching and clean results every time.

services.title: Woodwork & Doors
services.desc: Interior doors, skirting boards, and window frames painted to a high finish. We sand, prime, and apply quality topcoats.

services.title: Preparation & Specialist Finishes
services.desc: We don't cut corners on prep work. Plastering, filling, sanding, and specialist finishes like eggshell and satin applied correctly.

about_pullquote: I treat every room like I'm painting my own home.
about_para_1: BeeArtistic was founded on a simple belief: painting should be done right the first time. With over 12 years' hands-on experience across Leicester and the East Midlands, we've built our reputation on meticulous preparation, quality materials, and attention to detail that goes unseen until the finished room takes your breath away.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, turn up on time, and protect your home as if it were our own. We're fully insured, use premium paints, and take pride in leaving your space looking immaculate—no shortcuts, no shortcuts, no excuses.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About BeeArtistic

reviews.text: Had our lounge and hallway painted. The prep work was thorough, no mess left behind, and the finish is absolutely pristine. Mark was polite, professional, and knew his stuff. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Two-week turnaround on a full exterior repaint. Weather held up, work was spotless, and they matched the colour perfectly. Wouldn't hesitate to book again for the guest bedroom next year.

reviews.text: Used BeeArtistic for our office refresh during quiet hours. No disruption, arrived early, cleaned up after themselves. Bill was fair and the work is standing up brilliantly six months on.
